label: Cracking the Code: Which Ocular Symptoms Predict Dry Eye Signs? Insights From a Large International Sicca Registry.
summary: The study aimed to identify symptom-based predictors of dry eye disease (DED) signs in the Sjögren's International Collaborative Clinical Alliance (SICCA) cohort. We performed a retrospective analysis examining 16 ocular symptoms (most graded 0-4) and artificial tear (AT) use (graded 0-3) as predictors of DED signs (abnormal ocular surface staining [OSS] and Schirmer's test [ST], graded yes/no).
